_comment: Anchored text edits to src/Global.lua, applied by tools/tts_build.py --arno. Each 'find' must occur exactly once, otherwise the build fails (protects against silent mis-patching after a base-mod update). Keep every edit to a single call into ARNO.*; prefer wrappers in arno/adapter/hooks.lua whenever possible. Listed in CHANGES.md.

hooks.why: Add ARNO bots to `players` before setup_game builds per-colour components, so bot colours keep their boards, counters and tokens.
hooks.find:
table.insert(players, { color = player.color, steam_name = player.steam_name })
  end
hooks.replace:
table.insert(players, { color = player.color, steam_name = player.steam_name })
  end
  if ARNO then ARNO.setup.add_bots(players) end

hooks.why: ARNO 3.0: a human player is always the starting player.
hooks.replace: local starting_player = (ARNO and ARNO.setup.starting_player(players)) or players[math.random(#players)]

hooks.why: start_game waits for 4 discards per player; humans discard 4, ARNO discards his setup cards (not 4).
Card 471 African Spurred Tortoise: the base data lacks its Reptile House option (printed card: Reptile House 2, like the other size-3 reptiles 476/481). Upstream mod fix, applied in every game.
hooks.find: [471] = {type="animal", size=3, cost=22, icons={"reptile", "africa"}, rewards={"1 cp", "6 appeal", "sunbathing 3"}},
hooks.replace: [471] = {type="animal", size=3, cost=22, icons={"reptile", "africa"}, enclosure={repthouse=2}, rewards={"1 cp", "6 appeal", "sunbathing 3"}},
